description: This file provides utility functions for managing transactions within the OFBiz framework. It wraps around standard transaction API calls, offering methods for beginning, committing, rolling back, suspending, and resuming transactions, as well as managing transaction stamps, suspensions, and debugging resources.

classes.name: TransactionUtil
classes.description: A utility class facilitating transaction management in the OFBiz framework, supporting nested transactions, suspension, resumption, status checks, and debugging.

classes.name: TransactionUtil.NoTransaction
classes.description: A wrapper class for executing a Callable without beginning a transaction, suspending and resuming any ongoing transactions.

classes.name: TransactionUtil.InTransaction
classes.description: A wrapper class for executing a Callable within a transaction, handling begin, commit, and rollback logic.

classes.name: TransactionUtil.StampClearSync
classes.description: A Synchronization implementation that clears transaction stamps after completion.

classes.name: TransactionUtil.RollbackOnlyCause
classes.description: A class representing the cause for marking a transaction as rollback-only, including a message and an optional throwable.

methods.name: doNewTransaction
methods.description: Executes a Callable within a new transaction, handling exceptions and rollback on error.

methods.name: doTransaction
methods.description: Executes a Callable within an existing or new transaction.

methods.name: noTransaction
methods.description: Wraps a Callable to execute outside of any transaction context.

methods.name: inTransaction
methods.description: Wraps a Callable to execute within a transaction context, beginning and committing/ rolling back as needed.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts a new transaction if none is active in the current thread.

methods.name: internalBegin
methods.description: Helper method that actually begins the transaction with optional timeout.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current transaction status for the thread.

methods.name: getStatusString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the current transaction status.

methods.name: isTransactionInPlace
methods.description: Checks if a transaction is currently active in the thread.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction if one is active and was started by this utility.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction if one is active.

methods.name: setRollbackOnly
methods.description: Marks the current transaction so that it will rollback when completed.

methods.name: suspend
methods.description: Suspends the current transaction, returning the suspended Transaction object.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended transaction.

methods.name: enlistConnection
methods.description: Enlists an XAConnection into the current transaction and optionally provides a JDBC connection.

methods.name: enlistResource
methods.description: Enlists an XAResource with the current transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionStateString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string for a given transaction status code.

methods.name: getTransactionBeginStamp
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the timestamp marking the start of the current transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionUniqueNowStamp
methods.description: Generates a unique timestamp that is guaranteed not to conflict with previous stamps.

methods.name: clearTransactionStamps
methods.description: Resets transaction start and last timestamp fields.
